The probability that any given particle will be affected by this op.
For each incoming particle, the op generates a random number between 0 and 1 and if that number is greater than "probability", it ignores the particle and leaves it unchanged.

0.0 = never affects any particles.
1.0 = affects every particle.

description.plain_text: Expressions are evaluated per-particle. Particle fields that can be accessed are age, pos, vel, size, color, opacity, mass, life, id. Access to components of the Vec3s can be made with the functions mag, x, y, z. A Vec3 can be built out of 3 scalars with the function v(), e.g. v(0.1, 0.1, 0.1). A scalar is treated as a Vec3 with all three componenets set to that value.
